newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed in deserted markets.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed in deserted markets.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday in extremely thin trade with most market participants having left for the Christmas holiday.

Outright physical gas oil prices were slightly firmer on the back of IPE benchmark futures. The IPE January contract was trading 50 cents higher at $212.00 a tonne at 1004 GMT after having shed $3.50 on Monday.

The few gas oil traders to be found at their desks said heating oil barge premiums were unchanged from Monday at Jan IPE +50 cents/+$1 for second half December and Jan IPE +$1/+$2 for first half January.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were reported to have slipped with most players quoting $112/$113 fob ARA, although an ARA refiner was reported to have sold a barge at $110 fob ARA early on.
